brief_title: Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of LIB003 in HeFH Patients on Oral Lipid Therapy Needing Further LDL-C Reduction
official_title: Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 3 Study to Evaluate the Long-Term Efficacy and Safety of LIB003 in Heterozygous FH Patients on Stable Lipid-Lowering Therapy Requiring Additional LDL-C Reduction

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline Compared to Placebo in LDL-C Level Calculated by Friedwald Formula at Week 24
Change From Baseline Compared to Placebo in LDL-C Level Calculated by Friedwald Formula Using the Mean of Weeks 22 and 24

brief_summary: This study is to assess LDL-C reductions at Week 24 and the mean of Weeks 22 and 24 with monthly Q4W (≤31 days) dosing of LIB003 300 mg administered subcutaneously (SC) compared to placebo in patients 18 years or older with Heterozygous FH on stable diet and oral LDL-C lowering drug therapy.
